integrity_note: The 2014 corrigendum invalidates global planar absolute continuity in the original source. The theorem does not depend on this withdrawn assertion; all probabilistic objects are explicitly defined via reverse-branch kernels.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is about the canonical stable-coordinate conditional at the expanding-coordinate endpoint, not an invariant planar density or an almost-surely unique disintegration at a null point.
Convergence is in distribution on a shrinking spatial scale; no moment convergence or optimal error rate is claimed.
Independent historical-priority review has not been performed.
title: Pareto boundary layer at the intermittent limit of a reversible cusp map
